Friday, 6:50am, staff room at St Aldhelm's, paeds ward. Early shift; handover done, first coffee going cold. Through the window the sky is doing that pale November thing. Two unread threads on your phone: your mother, and — from last night, still sitting there like a receipt in a drawer — your mother-in-law. Home is twenty minutes and one whole day of talking away: Sunday roast in two days, Leeds in four.
